items.text: OLBG lists the Galway SFC final as 'Moycullen v Salthill-Knocknacarra'. The official Galway GAA schedule (published 23 Oct) has Maigh Cuilinn v Salthill-Knocknacarra at 16:00 on 25 Oct. The desk uses the official pairing.
OLBG displayed the USA v Australia A kickoff as 19:00 (Eastern view, = 23:00Z). Rugby Australia states 9:00am AEDT Sunday 25 Oct = 22:00Z. Official time used; OLBG is one hour off.

OLBG display times for the late NHL games (22:07/23:07 in the Eastern view) sit about 1h07m from the official 9:00/10:00 PM EDT starts, while the 7:00 PM EDT games show a +7-minute offset (19:07). Official NHL start times are used throughout.

OLBG tip distributions diverge sharply from the official standings for several NHL games (Carolina 10/11 away vs a 5-4-1 St Louis; New York Rangers 6/7 despite a 1-4-1 road record; Calgary 4/6 despite 3-6 with a -19 goal differential). Our lines follow the official statistics, not the tip share.

On several top-tier handball fixtures (including a PSG home game and EHF Champions League qualifiers) the most-tipped OLBG selection is 'Tie' with 50-71% of tips. That pattern is unusual at this level, so no high-confidence pick is taken from it; lines are published with the community share noted.

OLBG's most-tipped selection in San Antonio v Dallas is the Spurs (7/10, 70%) even though San Antonio are 0-2 and 0-2 on the road this season. Our line follows the official standings (Dallas at home).

WTA draw/schedule pages and the 26-Oct ATP round are client-side rendered, so the hosting tournament for these pairings could not be named from the official sites. The WTA update feed confirms Osaka (Kinoshita Group Japan Open) and Tokyo (Toray Pan Pacific Open) as the live Asia events. Pairings and start times are OLBG-derived and flagged.

OLBG's most-tipped selections in the three Italian fixtures favour the lower-ranked side (Cisterna over Trentino, Pordenone over Perugia, Padova over Civitanova). Our lines treat the league favourites as the model picks; the community share is recorded for reference.

GBGB does not publish a public online racecard for the 11:04 Doncaster. The runner list comes from the OLBG event page, which shows five named selections (a standard card carries six) — the list may be incomplete.

No official fixture page was found/captured for the Toronto Kings v Vancouver Guardians T20, the India Women v Zimbabwe Women 2nd ODI, Namibia v Ireland 3rd ODI, or the 31 Oct South Africa v Australia fixture. CSA Pro20 fixtures are confirmed except Eastern Storm v SA Emerging (aggregators only). These rows carry OLBG-derived times and no official link.

The OLBG golf hub showed 'No tips found' at 22:35Z (PGA TOUR Bermuda Championship R4 and DP World Tour Genesis Championship R4 are in play on the official tours, but no OLBG golf tips were listed). The golf page therefore carries context only and no picks.
The OLBG snooker hub showed 'No tips found' at 22:35Z; the Northern Ireland Open final (Kyren Wilson, 13:00Z per WST) listed earlier in the day had expired. Context only, no picks.
The OLBG motor racing hub showed 'No tips found' at 22:35Z; the F1 United States Grand Prix (Round 18, 25 Oct 20:00Z) listed earlier in the day had expired. Context only, no picks.

The OLBG rugby league hub listed only 2027 ante-post outrights at capture, even though Rugby League World Cup 2026 is in progress (nrl.com: Australia v Fiji, 25 Oct). The RLWC context is shown on the sport page, but picks are only for the OLBG-listed outrights.

The league-average scoring rate is computed from the 30 of 32 teams whose standings were captured (Chicago and Vancouver were not in the captured standings page). The impact on strength factors is under 1%.

NBA confidence is capped at medium: only 1-2 games had been played in 2026-27 at capture and the 2025-26 prior-season records sit behind a JavaScript selector on the official standings page and could not be captured.
OLBG displayed Harlequins v Saracens at 11:00 (Eastern view, = 15:00Z); the Premiership fixture listing (inherited official capture) has 11:00 UTC. Official time used.
OLBG displayed SC Magdeburg v RNL at 10:00 (Eastern view, = 14:00Z); the official league page (inherited capture) has 13:00 UTC. Official time used.
OLBG displayed the Almaty final at 06:00 (Eastern view, = 10:00Z); the ATP daily schedule says 'not before 14:00' Almaty local (UTC+5) = 09:00Z. Official used.
OLBG's most-tipped Game 2 selection is the Rays money line (13/22, 59%) although the Brewers are at home, lead the series 1-0 and have the stronger regular season. Our line favours Milwaukee.
